in_sanskrit.name: आत्मा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The self, the soul, the inner being or the true self of a person.

in_hindi.name: आत्मा
in_hindi.long_meaning: स्वतंत्र आत्मा, पुरुष का स्वीकृत अहंकार, जीवात्मा

in_marathi.name: Atma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Self or Soul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hinduism, Atma refers to the individual soul, the true self that is distinct from the body and the material world. It is the eternal, unchanging essence of a being, and the ultimate goal of spiritual life is to realize and unite with the universal Atma.

in_bengali.name: Atma
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Self or Soul
in_bengali.long_meaning: Atma একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hinduism, Atma refers to the individual soul, the true self that is distinct from the body and the material world. It is the eternal, unchanging essence of a being, and the ultimate goal of spiritual life is to realize and unite with the universal Atma.
